messages:
tess: Quick sync on Primus trial — we have a Wed demo (11/15) and need to lock owners + CRs. Can we list who owns infra, connector, and certs?
ryan: I can own infra config (VPC/subnet + routing). Need their staging creds and IP whitelist by EOD Tue.
maria: I'll own the connector + schema mapping. FYI PR is up (PR #542). Planning to finish mapping EOD Tue.
sanjay: Certs/network: blocked on customer VPN details. I messaged their infra yesterday, no reply yet. Fallback is relay via our proxy but need security approval.
olivia: Demo success criteria from AE: 1) p50 inference <200ms, 2) end-to-end with sample customer payload, 3) RBAC + audit logs visible in console.
tess: @ryan @maria please confirm PRs + test coverage. Also we need a smoke test that verifies embeddings + reranking pipeline.
ryan: Infra branch ready but CI failing on one env var. @deploy-bot any pipeline logs?
deploy-bot: CI build failed for branch infra-setup: missing env var REDWOOD_VPC_ID. See logs: https://ci.redwood/example/logs/infra-setup (truncated).
sanjay: I'll open a security ticket to enable proxy fallback if we don't get VPN details: TKT-789. That should unblock demo path.
maria: Added a quick smoke test (curl) to validate embeddings endpoint, snippet below:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"input":"test embed"}' \ 
  https://staging.primus.redwood/v1/embeddings | jq
```
This will be in PR #542.
tess: Who can run a Wed morning dry-run (10:00am PT)? prefer both infra + connector present.
ryan: I can do Wed 10am PT with Maria. I'll coordinate with their staging SRE and send calendar invite.
olivia: Also confirm dashboards: create alert p50 > 250ms and on-call tagged. Add canary traffic for 5 mins before demo.
tess: @sanjay please add security contact to the invite. After PR merge, can we trigger infra pipeline? @deploy-bot queue it please.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: infra-setup -> staging (manual approval required).
maria: Quick CR ping to @ryan for infra PR link in my connector branch — need review on env var handling.
ryan: I'll review this afternoon. If CI passes and security signs off on proxy fallback, we should be green for dry-run.
sanjay: Security is OK with proxy fallback if we redact any PII in logs. I'll attach the policy to the ticket.
tess: Summary: owners — infra: @ryan, connector: @maria, network/certs: @sanjay, PM: @olivia. Dry-run Wed 10am PT. Next actions: ryan send invite, maria finish PR/tests, sanjay open/track TKT-789, olivia set alerts.
olivia: I'll add the dashboard + alert and post links here when ready.
tess: Perfect — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
ryan: 👍 will update by EOD.
deploy-bot: Notation: last pipeline event queued at 1712351259.
